name: Orpheus
subtitle: Master of Melody
description: Invoker that places many buffs while reviving and increasing divinity.
lore: A brilliant poet and musician capable of charming most creatures, Orpheus is most famous for his quest to rescue his wife Eurydice from the underworld—a quest he failed. Since the Shattering, his grief has soured his love for song and frivolity. Now he uses his music to draw souls away from the underworld in an effort to be avenged upon Hades for his failure to retrieve his beloved.
divinity_generator: Gain [25] Divinity when placing a [buff] on an ally.

skills.name: Invigorating Chrord
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 150%ATK, then increase the turn meter of all allies by 3%. If Eurydice is in the team, increase turn meter of all allies by 6% instead.
skills.awakening_bonus: Also increase Divinity of all allies by [40]. If Eurydice is in the team, increase the Divinity by [70].

skills.name: Melodic Mastery
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 220%ATK, then place [mechanic:atk-up-i] and [mechanic:acc-up-i] for 1 turn on all allies.

skills.name: Harmony of Eurydice
skills.description: Place [mechanic:spd-up-i] and [mechanic:init-up-i] for 1 turn on all allies. If Eurydice is on the team and is defeated, revive her with 50% HP and 50% Turn Meter.
